name: Factory
summary: Factory builds AI systems for software development, aiming to help enterprises create and improve software with governed agents. It raised $200 million at a $5 billion valuation in September 2026.
overview: Factory provides AI software-development tools for enterprises. Its platform is designed to govern a single system across the software-development lifecycle rather than stitch together separate coding agents.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Factory announced the financing and valuation in September 2026.

bull_case: If enterprise coding agents become a core development workflow, Factory can benefit from deep integration, governance and measurable ROI.
bear_case: Developer AI is intensely competitive and moves with the underlying-model ecosystem; a $5B valuation requires sustained enterprise adoption and defensibility.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Enterprise software-development platform for governed AI agents.
company: Factory develops AI systems intended to help enterprises build and improve software. It focuses on governed workflows across the development lifecycle, including tools that make AI-agent effectiveness measurable.

In September 2026, Factory announced a $200 million financing at a $5 billion valuation, taking total funding above $400 million. It said hundreds of thousands of developers use the platform, including teams at Nvidia, Blackstone, RBC, Adobe and T-Mobile.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Factory is a direct private-market bet on AI changing the economics of enterprise software production. Retention, deployment depth and governance requirements will determine whether that becomes a durable platform category.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: Factory was founded in 2023 to build autonomous software-engineering systems for enterprises.
Its $200M September 2026 financing was company-announced at a $5B valuation.
The core diligence question is whether governed deployment turns usage into durable enterprise spend.
